payload.subject: debug.oma-shim-root-cause
payload.decision: Treat stale Bun-generated oma shim from bunx --global as the root cause and use bun add -g oh-my-agent@latest for durable global install.
payload.rationale: The old oma.bunx embedded ..\node_modules\oh-my-agent\bin\cli.js and failed with MODULE_NOT_FOUND; after bun add -g, oma.bunx points to install\global\node_modules and oma state:emit/help runs.

payload.subject: debug.oma-global-config
payload.decision: Global OMA CLI is installed and global oma-config.yaml is aligned to the user OpenCode-local preset.
payload.rationale: bun add -g fixed the stale oma shim; global config now uses model_preset opencode-local, default_cli opencode, and vendors opencode.
